summary: Comprehensive test suite with good organization and real CI/CD validation through act integration. Covers all core requirements (config loading, status computation, report generation, formatting, CLI, workflow). Tests are well-separated by concern (unit/CLI/workflow/integration), use clear fixtures and helper functions, and include both happy path and error scenarios with boundary conditions. Main weaknesses: fixture files and module implementation aren't provided (can't verify test data completeness), regex-based output parsing in ActPipeline tests could be fragile to formatting changes, missing tests for timezone handling and performance/scale scenarios. Assuming supporting files are correct, this would catch most regressions effectively.
